raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
# Description

`minimum_versions.yml` only runs on `pull_request`. sccache's GitHub Actions cache backend therefore stores every compiled object in a PR-scoped cache (`refs/pull/<N>/merge`), which no other PR can read. When we checked, the repo had 0 cache entries on `main` and ~24.6k PR-scoped ones. As a result every new PR's first run compiles TE from scratch: ~2.6% sccache hit rate and ~60 min median wall time, versus ~10 min per job once that PR's own cache is warm.

Running the workflow on pushes to `main` fills the base-branch cache scope, which PR runs can restore.

Fixes # (none filed)

## Type of change

- [ ] Documentation change (change only to the documentation, either a fix or a new content)
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [x] Infra/Build change
- [ ] Code refactoring

## Changes

- Add `push: branches: [main]` to `.github/workflows/minimum_versions.yml` (3 lines).

## Measurement

Measured on a fork (agarg21/TransformerEngine), 3 fresh PRs per arm, all green:

| | First run of a new PR (median) | Job-minutes per run | sccache hit rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| Before (no main scope) | 63.9 min | 116 | 2.6% |
| After (main warmed by one push run) | 14.7 min | 24 | 96.4% |

Fork run IDs: before 39471922855, 39471924582, 39471927842; after 39496253340, 39496257361, 39496261774; warm-up push run 39482052619.

Caveats:
- Only each PR's first run benefits; later pushes to the same PR already hit that PR's own cache. That is roughly 88 of ~986 PR runs/month.
- Cost: one extra build per merge to `main` on GitHub-hosted runners, mostly warm after the first.
- Revert: remove the 3 lines.

# Checklist:

- [x] I have read and followed the [contributing guidelines](https://github.com/NVIDIA/TransformerEngine/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.rst)
- [x] The functionality is complete
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation
- [x] My changes generate no new warnings
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes

detail.title: Run minimum-versions build on pushes to main to warm sccache

files.patch:
@@ -6,7 +6,12 @@
 name: 'Minimum supported versions'
 on:
   pull_request:
+  push:
+    branches:
+      - main
   workflow_dispatch:
+permissions:
+  contents: read
 concurrency:
   group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
   cancel-in-progress: true
